claims.sourceText: John Lear's Dec. 29, 1987 Statement, Internet Archive item uploaded by Rich Geldreich 10 June 2023, https://archive.org/details/john-lear-statement-1987 , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: HIS OWN CLAIM DOCUMENT IS DATED AND PRECEDES LAZAR. A statement by Lear dated 29 December 1987, originally a physical letter to the Borderland Sciences Research Foundation, survives in the BSRA/BSRF holdings at the Archives for the Unexplained and was, on the uploader's account, circulated on the ParaNet bulletin board in early 1988. This is roughly eighteen months before Lazar reached KLAS-TV. The item record was opened; the statement's text was not rendered by the fetch and no content from it is asserted.
